scripts.check_all: npm run format && npm run check && npm run test && npm run db:seed:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run dev:worker
scripts.e2e:server: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:check: rm -rf .wrangler/seed-check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/seed-check && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/seed-check --file db/seed.sql
